core_obligations: Construct the map on the defining ideal sheaves from the commutativity of the square.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up the two immersions and their defining ideal sheaves.
Construct the map between the conormal algebras.
Check it is a map of graded algebras and functorial.

difficulty_reason: Given a commutative square of algebraic spaces whose horizontal arrows are immersions, the lemma produces a canonical map of graded algebras from the pullback of the conormal algebra of the lower immersion to the conormal algebra of the upper one. The proof constructs the map on the level of the sheaves of ideals defining the immersions, verifies that it respects the graded algebra structures, and checks compatibility with the pullback along the vertical maps. Constructing the graded map and checking multiplicativity is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 722-768.
